assumptions.statement: No cleared official SITE_BOUNDARY or three KEY_AREA polygon package is available in this submission; the included geometry is repository-maintained provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: It supports intake visualization, topology checks, and design discussion only. It is not an official redline, precise-area basis, statutory control, ownership boundary, or approval basis. This organizer data gap does not itself block content scoring; when official polygons arrive, all dependent layers, figures, PDFs, HTML, and area metrics must be recalculated.
assumptions.trigger: receipt or revision of organiser-cleared official scope polygons
assumptions.responsible_role: authorised planning-data custodian and spatial-analysis professional
assumptions.resolution_evidence: source-registered official polygons, CRS record, topology review, and regenerated metric report

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory-plan controls, including floor-area ratio, building height, density, setbacks, land-use controls, and any statutory intensity conclusion, are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: They remain unknown and cannot be inferred from the submission geometry, provisional areas, concept diagrams, or global cases. Any numerical control, zoning adjustment, or approval conclusion requires official attachments and professional confirmation. Registering official values published for adjacent, already-exhibited parcels is a factual reference and does not infer a control value for any parcel in this proposal; the register records what was verified through public channels on 2026-08-11 and leaves the intensity metrics unknown.
assumptions.trigger: receipt of applicable official planning controls and their calculation boundary
assumptions.resolution_evidence: source-registered control document, applicability note, and signed professional calculation record

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, station interfaces, pedestrian counts, utilities, drainage, power, communications, fire access, flood conditions, heritage controls, and construction constraints have not been cleared for this package.
assumptions.impact: Routes, interfaces, municipal systems, service-robot operations, and public-space components are conceptual relationships only. They are not engineering alignments, municipal commitments, fire-safety conclusions, or heritage-control determinations.
assumptions.trigger: receipt of applicable road, station, utility, flood, fire, and heritage records plus field survey
assumptions.responsible_role: transport, municipal, fire-safety, flood, and heritage professionals
assumptions.resolution_evidence: discipline-specific source register, field-survey record, conflict review, and authorised design boundary

assumptions.statement: No cleared building survey, parcel-rights record, tenancy record, structural assessment, age/use inventory, or heritage assessment is available for the conceptual building and land-use layers.
assumptions.impact: The package cannot determine retain, renovate, demolish, new-build, acquisition, relocation, or approved development scope. Those layers express a reviewable design hypothesis only.
assumptions.trigger: completion of a cleared parcel, building, tenancy, structure, use, and heritage survey
assumptions.responsible_role: building-survey, property, structural, and heritage professionals
assumptions.resolution_evidence: building-by-building survey register, rights record, professional condition assessment, and decision log

assumptions.statement: No cleared site-wide accessibility audit, sensory-load survey, or independent-task baseline is available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Inclusive performance metrics remain unknown; the proposal supplies test methods and spatial hypotheses rather than invented target values.
assumptions.trigger: approval of the field-audit protocol and completion of participant-reviewed route and service inventories
assumptions.responsible_role: accessibility, environmental-assessment, and transport professionals with participant representatives
assumptions.resolution_evidence: audit protocol, reasonable-accommodation record, route inventory, anonymised observation log, and independent review

assumptions.statement: The AI agent has not represented or completed co-design with disabled people, neurodivergent people, older adults, children, caregivers, or international visitors.
assumptions.impact: All persona needs and scenario details are provisional prompts for voluntary, accessible, privacy-preserving co-design with real participants.
assumptions.trigger: approval of ethics, recruitment, accommodation, consent, withdrawal, and disposal protocols
assumptions.responsible_role: co-design lead, ethics reviewer, and participant advisory group
assumptions.resolution_evidence: approved protocol, voluntary participation record, role-coverage calculation, change receipt, and withdrawal log

assumptions.statement: No approved implementation owner, operating entity, procurement plan, investment budget, subsidy, partnership, activity permit, development timetable, or government commitment has been provided.
assumptions.impact: Phases, Every Sense Week, trials, maintenance, procurement, and exit mechanisms are concept recommendations for responsible organisations and professional teams to evaluate; they are not confirmed delivery, funding, activity, or government arrangements.
assumptions.trigger: written appointment of an accountable sponsor or operator and approval of a bounded work package
assumptions.responsible_role: future authorised project sponsor or operator
assumptions.resolution_evidence: written responsibility record, approved work-package boundary, maintenance resource, stop condition, and next authorisation

assumptions.statement: Global cases have different land, capital, legal, institutional, and operating conditions.
assumptions.impact: Only mechanisms are compared; no foreign outcome, regulation, or delivery commitment is transferred to Haidian.
assumptions.trigger: any proposal to convert a referenced mechanism into a local delivery claim
assumptions.responsible_role: urban-design research lead and relevant legal or policy reviewer
assumptions.resolution_evidence: local applicability analysis with source, authority, resource, and operating differences stated
recalculation_scope: case-comparison claims only; no quantitative metric transfer

assumptions.statement: OP-01 through OP-10 are stable scenario anchors in geometry/constraints.geojson and correspond in order to S01 through S10; they are conceptual operation points, not surveyed, approved, funded, or built facilities.
assumptions.impact: The identifiers can bind narrative, matrices, scenarios, risks, and future tests, but their coordinates and installation conditions cannot support an engineering or delivery claim.
assumptions.trigger: field placement review, official geometry integration, or revision of any scenario-to-node mapping
assumptions.responsible_role: urban designer, site manager, accessibility professional, and future authorised operator
assumptions.resolution_evidence: field-reviewed point register, conflict check, responsible owner, stop condition, and G3 decision record
recalculation_scope: scenario-node cross-references and all dependent route, service, and risk matrices
